preconditions.description: The integer d is between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The integer s is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value % d == 0 and sum(int(digit) for digit in str(return_value)) == s)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no such number exists, or a number that is divisible by d and has a sum of digits equal to s.
